# pvecli vm add

Create a new VM interactively or with options.

```text
pvecli vm add [NODE] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node name. |

## Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile to use. |
| `-id`, `--vmid N` |  | VM ID (auto-assigned if not specified). |
| `-na`, `--name VALUE` |  | VM name. |
| `-pl`, `--pool VALUE` |  | Pool name. |
| `-ob`, `--onboot` / `--no-onboot` |  | Start at boot. |
| `-iss`, `--iso-storage VALUE` |  | Storage for ISO. |
| `-i`, `--iso VALUE` |  | ISO file name (from iso-storage). |
| `-ot`, `--os-type VALUE` |  | OS type: linux or windows. |
| `-ov`, `--os-version VALUE` |  | OS version (e.g., '11/2022/2025', '6.x'). |
| `-ag`, `--agent` / `--no-agent` | `--agent` | Enable QEMU Guest Agent. |
| `-so`, `--sockets N` |  | CPU sockets. |
| `-co`, `--cores N` |  | CPU cores per socket. |
| `-vc`, `--vcpus N` |  | vCPU count at startup. |
| `-ct`, `--cpu-type VALUE` |  | CPU type: x86-64-v2-AES or host. |
| `-me`, `--memory N` |  | RAM in MiB. |
| `-ds`, `--disk-storage VALUE` |  | Storage for primary disk. |
| `-dz`, `--disk-size N` |  | Disk size in GB. |
| `-df`, `--disk-format VALUE` |  | Disk format: qcow2, raw, vmdk. |
| `-br`, `--bridge VALUE` |  | Network bridge. |
| `-vl`, `--vlan VALUE` |  | VLAN tag. |
| `-fw`, `--firewall` / `--no-firewall` |  | Enable firewall. |
| `-ld`, `--link-down` / `--no-link-down` |  | Start disconnected. |
| `-vis`, `--virtio-iso-storage VALUE` |  | Storage for VirtIO ISO (Windows only). |
| `-vi`, `--virtio-iso VALUE` |  | VirtIO ISO file name (Windows only). |
| `-ts`, `--tpm-storage VALUE` |  | Storage for TPM (Windows 11/2022/2025 only). |
| `-es`, `--efi-storage VALUE` |  | Storage for EFI (Windows 11/2022/2025 only). |
